title: Serve without making yourself the headline
summary: This meets the part of service still wanting witness, credit, or moral glow. The line is sharp: clean service does not advertise itself.
takeaway: Make hiddenness part of the offering.
lifeApplication: Before posting, explaining, or subtly displaying the good you did, let the act stay unadvertised. Make hiddenness part of the offering.

source.shortMeaning: Service becomes pure when the self stops asking to be noticed.
source.lifeApplication: Before displaying the good you did, let the act stay hidden.

evidence.coreClaim: Service becomes pure when the self stops asking to be noticed.
evidence.turn: Service becomes true when the self stops asking to be seen.
evidence.practicalImplication: Before posting, explaining, or subtly displaying the good you did, let the act stay unadvertised. Make hiddenness part of the offering.
